title: Command
description: The ⌘K palette: one input that searches actions and pages, driven from the keyboard.
a11y: Native modal dialog. Search keeps focus on a labelled combobox; Up/Down loop through listbox options, Enter activates a command, Escape closes and restores the opener. Empty results and a polite result count are provided. Composition events and IME keys are ignored during selection. One shared Cmd/Ctrl+K document listener per script load serves every palette; loading the script twice adds none.
